report:
Reviewed the complete identity_only claim, its sole ordinary implementation association in sage_ir::check::resolve, and its complete test set (the sole TODO semantic_spec test). Independently verified exact byte equality of both current source files against the historical implementation_sources/test_sources snapshots; the historical rationale remains applicable, not a substitute for this assessment.

Source assessment: resolve_path and resolve_name_from_scope return rib resolutions or mapped symbols. Their in-file traversal resolves relative/anchored segments, names, imports and preludes using symbol/module identity operations, rather than invoking receiver inference, associated-type normalization, obligation proving or applicable-method selection. traits_in_method_scope enumerates identities and a completeness boolean without selecting a method. Ordinary path/name resolution currently returns vectors; full identity/completeness semantics and transitive execution-boundary verification remain the documented gap, not established by this review. The visible FIXME for type-dependent paths does not implement inference as a hidden side effect.

The sole test resolution_lookup_identity_only has no assertions and supplies no behavioral evidence. Its explicit TODO requires normalized representative lookup traces restricted to searched scopes, imports and identity/metadata operations, excluding inference, trait-solver, candidate-signature and checked-body execution. This adequately preserves the deferred verification boundary, including associated-type normalization and method applicability. Completing it requires representative lookup fixtures and query-trace instrumentation/assertions that distinguish these semantic operations, plus assertions of identities and completeness results; current source inspection cannot prove those negative transitive execution guarantees. A hidden normalization or method-candidate query would not be caught by the present placeholder. Accepting this existing deferral does not certify complete implementation or test adequacy, and no reclassification is made.

Execution: personally ran review start, snapshot byte comparisons, review read for review policy, and review record. No behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build passing; these are baseline execution context only and cannot discharge the TODO. No additional implementation helpers were relied on beyond the captured implementation file and prior supplied rationale. No edits requested.
